name: amm
description: An AMM over 1Color tokens, the Open Exchange (docs/AMM.md): the overlay engine (shruggr/skein-overlay 0.16.0, required: chain/1; its filter sync answers the overlay sync protocol, libp2p /skein/overlay/sync/1.0.0, through the front door on that row: a read, nothing logged, shruggr/skein#154; its receive row, libp2p /skein/overlay/beef/1.0.0 (filter kernel.beef, handler overlay.submit), takes each Atomic BEEF a catch-up fetches, handed to it by the host as from the serving peer) with the 1Color components (shruggr/skein-1color 0.11.3, BRC-162 and BRC-207: the topic manager color-topic, one topic per token tm_color_<assetId> (BRC-207: tm_color_<txid>_0, tm_color_<txid>_<vout>) and the discovery topic tm_color; the lookups ls_color, ls_color_deploys and each token's ls_color_<assetId>, one index; the token list, the read route /color/tokens of color-lookup), the pool lookup ls_amm (amm-lookup, one service over every token topic, each query naming its token: a pool is listed only when it attests itself: its ValidatorPubKey the ValidatorIdentity's child keyed by the Nonce in its state, derived by the lookup, and the Affirmation in its state that key's signature of the pool's parameters; a Swap's continuation of a listed pool is listed when its ValidatorPubKey is the identity's child keyed by the spent pool outpoint; the LP's Close and the validator's Rescind end it; registered by root beside its declaration, it beats on ls_amm-live, per token, this skein's per-validator totals of its listed pools: the prices), the validator (amm-validator: swap as a libp2p direct call, it signs last and submits to its own overlay by message, {fn: "submit"} in the box submit (<app>/submit); affirm, called in-VM by amm.pool.affirm: a proposed pool checked against the validator's terms (0.15.0: the record amm/terms {lpFeeBps, validatorFeeBps, commissionBps} root sets with {fn: "terms", args} in the box amm/validator, args null clearing them; none set, a market only: affirm and the swap signing refused "no terms: this skein validates nothing", amm.pool.terms "no validator here", the beat without terms; no fee numbers in the manifest), a random nonce picked, the validator's key derived from it and the pool signed by that key, answered {validatorPubKey, nonce, signature}; and root's {fn: "rescind", args: {pool}} in the box validator (<app>/validator): the contract's Rescind, the pool written back with its ValidatorPubKey cleared, the pool a caller input of the instance's wallet, which pays the fee) and amm-p2p: the marketplace relay (its box <app>/amm-p2p and the route /call; amm.swap/1: terms (the relay's commission pkh, hash160 of the instance's own key for the relay: BRC-43 level 1, protocol amm commission, key ID relay, counterparty anyone; no config since 0.16.0; and the market's minCommissionBps, the record amm/market {minCommissionBps} root sets with {fn: "market", args: {minCommissionBps}} in the box amm/amm-p2p, args null clearing it, unset 0: a listing preference of this market, the pools the Swap page lists, the relay refusing nothing by it), a taker's swap carried to the validator the caller names by identity key and libp2p peer ID, dialled, or handed in-VM to this instance's own amm-validator when that peer is this node; amm.pool/1: terms, and affirm, answered by this instance's own validator in-VM), the holders' listing requests (box <app>/requests, anyone; the read route /requests), the chain state of an outpoint (the read route /spends), and the pages, www/ served from the app's own tree by the read route / (its filter page, amm-p2p's serve; at the origin root by root's route to the same filter). The contract is Swap (the validator's), Close (the LP's alone, its outputs free) and Rescind (the validator's: the pool written back with its ValidatorPubKey cleared, no Swap after it). A deploy is the LP's wallet's (BRC-207), submitted to the token topic like any token transaction. Anyone submits to the engine by message in the box submit, answered by message, or by POST /submit, BRC-22: it waits and answers the STEAK. The manifest declares no topics: root registers each token with the engine in the box register (<app>/register; roles: {root: [register, registerLookup, deregisterLookup, rescind, terms, market]}): {fn: "register", args: {topic: "tm_color_<assetId>", program: "color-topic", seed: ["<the deploy txid>"]}} (the seed admits the token's deploy, admitted by the discovery topic, into its own topic: skein-overlay 0.7.8; without it the topic starts empty and the module's deploy check refuses every pool deploy: 0.16.1), {fn: "registerLookup", args: {service: "ls_color_<assetId>", program: "color-lookup", topics: ["tm_color_<assetId>"]}} and {fn: "registerLookup", args: {service: "ls_amm", program: "amm-lookup"}}; deregisterLookup then deregister drop it. Every skein is a market and a validator, always (skein-overlay 0.12): a register asks liveness of and beacons the topic's tm_color_<txid>_0-live (config.overlay.market {window} / .validator {every}, else 40 000 / 30 000 ms; this manifest sets neither).
